turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope you're having a good Tuesday. Are you getting ready to head out for another night shift at the ER?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, just getting my things together before I go. It's still pretty warm here in Phoenix even after sunset. I'm actually about to walk over and catch the late-night municipal bus to the hospital tonight instead of driving.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: The night bus sounds like a good way to save some energy before a long shift. Do you usually listen to something to pass the time on the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. Tonight I have a really funny show queued up where two stand-up comics roast terrible old movies. It always gets me laughing, which is a great way to prep for the chaos of the emergency room.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A humorous show sounds like the perfect pre-work stress reliever! What's the name of the program you're listening to?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's called 'How Did This Get Made?'. They just tear these awful films apart, and it honestly cracks me up. The bus ride always goes by so much faster when I have that playing.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I've heard great things about that one! Speaking of having fun, have you and Tom managed to get any salsa dancing in recently, or has your work schedule been too hectic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually went out to our usual salsa spot last Friday night! It was so much fun, even though my feet were pretty sore by the end of it. Tom is really improving on his turns.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear! It must be nice to have that regular outlet to disconnect from the intensity of the hospital.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It really is. We are hoping to go again next weekend if our schedules align, but my ER shifts can be pretty unpredictable.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, ER nursing definitely keeps you on your toes. Well, I hope tonight's shift goes smoothly and isn't too overwhelming for you!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm heading out the door to the bus stop now. I'll chat with you tomorrow!
